mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, we are enjoying fair conditions at 70 degrees by the Verona Public Library. There is no rain in the forecast for tonight.

There is a public information meeting scheduled for December 8 at the Verona Senior Center regarding the Military Ridge State Trail paving project. The project includes bridge replacements and trail paving near Verona Area High School. Additionally, city services like refuse and recycling remain available through Pellitteri Waste Systems.
Today you can join Yoga at Insight Wellness. Tomorrow, we have a variety of trivia events at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, and Paddy Mac's, plus live music.
In a recent report, officers responded on November 9 to a vehicle on U S H 18/151 that was swerving, resulting in an arrest for an O W I, third offence.
Chocolate Volcano is today's flavor of the day. The store is currently open and will be serving until 10 PM.
